segments.text: To honor the history and the culture of this dance and our culture, we always begin and end every lesson with the salutation.
A salutation is a way of offering prayer, greetings, and seeking blessings of the god, the guru, or the teacher and the audience.
You listen to two terms very often, posture and adavus. A posture is a frozen position of the body. Posture gives you balance and alignment.
These postures are the foundations of bharatanatyam and can come to life with movement to create basic steps called adavus.
The first posture is called samapadam, where the dancer's feet are placed close to each other and the body nice and straight, neither too relaxed nor too firm.
